sequence_points.name: Architectural Courtyard with Palm Tree and Animals
sequence_points.description: A serene architectural scene featuring a pink-walled courtyard with an arched opening, framed by a palm tree under a clear blue sky. Two dark silhouetted animals, possibly cats or small dogs, are positioned on the ground, adding a sense of scale and life to the minimalist composition.

sequence_points.name: Architectural Tunnel Perspective
sequence_points.description: A painting depicting a long, receding tunnel with arched wooden walls and a central pathway leading to a distant light. The composition uses perspective to create depth, with warm brown tones dominating the structure against a dark background.
